name: x402 Existing Hono Route Gating Without Deployment
query: Add x402 payment gating to this existing Hono route on Radius Testnet. Charge 0.001 SBC per request. Do not choose or configure deployment infrastructure.
context: The user already has a Hono application. The task is limited to payment behavior and local validation.
expected_behavior: Adds radius-sdk and uses radiusPayments from radius-sdk/hono
Sets network testnet, the supplied Testnet payTo address, and a GET or POST route key matching the existing route
Uses 0.001 SBC as a display-unit price
Validates an unpaid 402 and a paid retry locally
Explains the settle-before default and the delivery-failure logging requirement
Does not select Cloudflare, Railway, or another hosting platform
success_criteria: The existing application structure is preserved
radiusPayments is wired before the protected handler
No private key is added to the seller
Deployment remains out of scope while local x402 behavior is complete
